name: WhatsApp Bridge
description: HTTP-in → WhatsApp-out bridge. Exposes POST /api/whatsapp-bridge/send so external services can dispatch WhatsApp messages through this bot's already-paired Baileys session.

token.description: Bearer token required on POST /api/whatsapp-bridge/send. Set this to a random secret and share it only with trusted callers. If unset, the route is disabled.

path.description: HTTP path the route is mounted at.

accountId.description: Default WhatsApp accountId to send through. Optional — omit to use the bot's default account.

maxBodyBytes.description: Maximum request body size in bytes.
